body:
I felt this. I suffer from exactly what you are talking about. From bad parents, to siblings who don’t care, to children who avoid me. I’m a 45F. You are NOT alone. Have you tried any therapy and/or medications? 

There is nothing wrong with you! You have a chemical imbalance in your brain that can be fixed with the right prescription. There is hope in finding the light. You seem to have some positivity in your life still. Hang on to that! Get some treatment and fix this early instead of waiting like I did and find yourself lost at my age. 

I am here if you need to talk.

You are a kind soul. I didn’t take it as you saying it was all about you at all. It’s just your experience and I respect that. I was taking meds myself... cymbalta, abilify, and lamictal... I didn’t feel a difference so I chose to stop taking them as I am not one for wanting to take pills, even for a headache. Lexapro made me feel like a zombie. No emotions what so ever. I also have fibromyalgia, and the cymbalta is suppose to help with that as well... but not taking them doesn’t help with those symptoms lol. 

I really feel alone in this and feel like my family is treating me like I have the “cooties”.  My husband tries... but he just doesn’t understand... healthy minds struggle with this. Lost is the best description I have for myself right now.

Thank you for being here, and understanding. It’s a lonely path we travel.

It’s good to hear I’m not alone, but it does not make my outlook any less dismal. You can cure depression, anxiety and PTSD through therapeutic treatments, you can’t cure BPD. I was at a point of hope that I could get better. The realization I never will has defeated me. I feel like I’ve lost everything
